[[AWS/Management & Governance Services/Amazon CloudWatch]] monitors, observes and creates metrices of how resources and applications are performing.

# Problems Solved
- *Operational Visibility*: Povides metrics, logs, and trace data across entire AWS infrastructure from a single dashboard.
- *proactive Alerting*: Triggers alarms when thresholds are breached
- *Automated Incident Response* Acts as an event router ([[Amazon Eventbridge]]) to trigger [[AWS Lambda]] or [[Systems Manager (SSM)]] runbooks when system states change

# Core/Sub features
- *CloudWatch Metrics*: 
	- collects performance data for AWS resources; for standard resources, every 5 minutes, for detailed monitoring, every 1-minute.
		- CPU
		- Disk I/O
		- Network
	- Custom Metrics: Requires CloudWatch Agent to measure:
		- RAM/Memory utilization
		- disk space used
		- custom app metrics
- *CloudWatch Logs*:
	- Centralizes application metrices within a log
		- Application logs
		- OS logs
		- AWS service logs
			- VPC Flow Logs
			- [[AWS Lambda]] execution logs
	- ** CloudWatch Logs Insights**:  allows you to query log data using SQL - like syntax
- *CloudWatch Alarms*: 
	- Metric Alarms: Monitors a single metric over time and executes actions
		- Auto Scaling Policies,
		- [[EC2 instances]] Reboot/Recover
		- SNS notification
	- Can combine multiple alarms using Boolean logic (and, or) to reduce alarm noise.
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
- *CloudWatch Metric Streams:* Continuously streams metrics to external destinations with near-real-time delivery
	- Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose
	- [[Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3)]]
	- Datadog
